topic: crubit cc_bindings_from_rs on linux-aarch64: the absence of prebuilt aarch64 bindings generators anywhere in the ecosystem, and the native-build route to producing them inside a Chromium toolchain

subtopics.scope: What crubit is and what cc_bindings_from_rs generates (rs_core.h, rs_alloc.h, rs_std.h headers) for Chromium C++ callers of Rust code via enable_cpp_api_from_rust.
seed_queries: crubit cc_bindings_from_rs Rust to C++ bindings generator

subtopics.scope: The ecosystem-wide absence of prebuilt cc_bindings_from_rs binaries: zero GitHub releases, no CIPD or GCS artifacts, no distro packages on any architecture, forcing source builds.
seed_queries: crubit cc_bindings_from_rs prebuilt binary download release

subtopics.scope: crubit upstream CI reality: rust.yml workflows and the nightly matrix run x86_64-Linux only, the repo is active but distributes nothing, and the tracker has no arm64 host issues.
seed_queries: crubit github actions rust.yml nightly CI x86_64 linux

subtopics.scope: cc_bindings_from_rs as a pure-Rust cargo binary: manifest location, cargo build --release --locked, required Linux RUSTFLAGS for librustc_driver rpath, and the rustc-dev component requirement.
seed_queries: librustc_driver so rpath ORIGIN rustc-dev component

subtopics.scope: How Chromium packages its rust toolchain: the rust-toolchain CIPD platform variants (Linux_x64, Mac, Mac_arm64, Win), no Linux_arm64 variant, and cc_bindings_from_rs shipping inside the toolchain tarball.
seed_queries: chromium rust toolchain CIPD package platforms Linux_arm64

subtopics.scope: Chromium tools/rust/build_crubit.py: host-arch auto-detection for the Debian sysroot, the CRUBIT_BINS list at tag 141, and tracking bug 351793625 for building crubit on all host platforms.
seed_queries: chromium issue 351793625 crubit all host platforms

subtopics.scope: The GN plumbing that forces the generator: cpp_api_from_rust.gni hardcoded binary path and clang-format reference, rust.gni computed enable_cpp_api_from_rust that args.gn cannot disable, and the resulting build graph dependency.

Prior art for native linux-aarch64 Chromium builds: the jasonrandrews/build-chromium-linux-arm64 pipeline tested on Graviton with its arm64-rust-build.patch, which stops at bindgen and never builds crubit.
seed_queries: build chromium linux arm64 native graviton rust

subtopics.scope: The route (a) recipe and its mechanical risks: pinning the crubit revision, RUSTFLAGS rpath build with the toolchain rustc, installing the aarch64 binary into third_party/rust-toolchain/bin, rustc-dev bindings drift, --locked resolution, clang-format swap, and idempotent reinstallation after toolchain re-syncs.
